productNote: Legacy shade equality is not required; Grok judges role, contrast, and state distinction.
exclusions: validation, error, success, destructive, and semantic link-primary chrome
workflow dialogs (cloning, mass restriction, alignment, guidescan)
mixed open+hover+active compound rules that cannot split by pseudo-class
gradient border stops and solid fills mislabeled as disabled via :hover:not(:disabled)

roles.ownerNote: 315-row ledger has no non-pseudo button background row for linear-gradient(var(--app-button-top), var(--app-button-bottom)); App.css resting targets include .db-main-actions button and .db-table-pagination button.
roles.distinction: Resting enabled control fill; not list hover or selection wash.
roles.contrastNote: Token maps to shared button gradient stops in App.css.
roles.cannotReuseReason: List/selection tokens are flat fills, not button gradients.

roles.ownerNote: Honest production rule is button:hover / button:hover:not(:disabled) with linear-gradient(var(--app-button-top), var(--app-button-hover-bottom)). Ledger row 8e57e9f2760e4833 (button:hover #cfe4fb) is one gradient hover; no second non-beige gradient hover row exists in the 315-row ledger.
roles.distinction: Must read as hover on a control, not pressed or selected list row.
roles.contrastNote: Maps to --app-button-hover-bottom on the shared control hover gradient.
roles.cannotReuseReason: Solid --vg-interactive-hover is for rows/panels, not gradient controls.

roles.distinction: Would be :active gradient stop darker than hover on buttons.
roles.cannotReuseReason: Ledger has fewer than two unrelated button control surfaces with :active gradient need; splitter/resizer fills are solids, not control-gradient presses.

roles.ownerNote: Resting enabled controls already use button { border-color: var(--vg-control-border) } in App.css; no separate ledger row is required for the resting outline.
roles.distinction: Enabled control outline from --app-button-border; not hover accent borders or focus rings.
roles.cannotReuseReason: --vg-border is divider chrome, not button edge weight.

roles.ownerNote: Resting enabled controls already use button { color: var(--app-button-text) } (alias --vg-control-ink) in App.css scheme blocks.
roles.cannotReuseReason: --vg-text is body copy; selected ink is accent-colored.

roles.distinction: Generic row/menu hover wash; not selected or pressed control gradient.
roles.contrastNote: Hover-only startup document rows; excludes mixed hover+active menu rules and db-tree scheme panel-muted hovers.
roles.cannotReuseReason: Control hover gradient serves buttons, not flat list/menu hovers.

roles.distinction: Selected or active navigation fill; must differ from hover wash.
roles.contrastNote: Sidebar active and db main toolbar active fills may map to the selection palette without matching legacy beige hex.
roles.cannotReuseReason: Hover token is a separate wash in the palette.

roles.ownerNote: 315-row ledger has no honest selected+hover-only chrome row (compound is-selected:hover entries are scientific or solid accent fills).
roles.distinction: Hover while already selected; must differ from base selected fill.
roles.contrastNote: Bright scheme may share #eaf4ff with table-hover; selected base remains #dcecff in bright.
roles.cannotReuseReason: Plain hover would collapse selected vs selected-hover states.

roles.ownerNote: Honest production: .sidebar-tool summary.is-active / .sidebar-tool-button.is-active { color: var(--app-selection-text) } and scheme .db-main-actions button.is-active { color: var(--app-selection-text) }. Ledger row 65c612c619231da9 is the sole color row; no second non-scientific ledger id.
roles.distinction: Ink on selected/active navigation; not body or control ink.
roles.contrastNote: Must stay readable on --vg-interactive-selected at ≥4.5:1 in all schemes.
roles.cannotReuseReason: --vg-control-ink is neutral; --vg-text-muted is too weak for selection.

roles.ownerNote: 315-row ledger has no two generic outline/border-color :focus-visible rows outside scientific viewers, semantic primary outlines, or workflow-only dialogs.
roles.distinction: Focus ring/outline color on normal, hover, and selected targets.
roles.cannotReuseReason: Selection fills are backgrounds; focus must remain visible on any state.

roles.ownerNote: 315-row ledger lacks two generic :disabled color rows outside semantic primary, scientific, and workflow-only selectors.
roles.distinction: Disabled label still readable; not enabled control ink.
roles.contrastNote: Target ≥4.0:1 on --vg-disabled-surface; may be below 4.5:1 on beige/bright panel-muted.

roles.ownerNote: 315-row ledger lacks two generic :disabled background rows without opacity-only or semantic primary chrome.
roles.distinction: Flat disabled control fill; not hover or selection.
roles.contrastNote: Uses scheme panel-muted; no dialog one-off hex.

roles.ownerNote: 315-row ledger lacks two generic :disabled border-color rows outside semantic primary and scientific controls.
roles.distinction: Muted edge for disabled controls; not focus or enabled border.
roles.contrastNote: Documented solids are computed color-mix values per scheme.
